# Revocation artifacts signed with a weak hash (RFC 8446 4.4.2.4 MD5 MUST / SHA-1 RECOMMENDED refusal, applied to OCSP and CRL).
# ca_cert / leaf_cert are CrlScope.txt's (EC P-256 CA serial 1 -> leaf serial 0x1234, issued by ca_key). Every artifact below
# is genuine and valid (window 2020-01-01..2099-12-31 or OCSP now..+100y) apart from the hash it was signed with.
#   crl_clean_sha256 / crl_revoked_sha256  - whole-scope CRL by ca_key, ecdsa-with-SHA256; clean / revoking 0x1234 (keyCompromise)
#   crl_clean_sha1   / crl_revoked_sha1    - the same two CRLs signed ecdsa-with-SHA1
#   ocsp_ca_sha256 / ocsp_ca_sha1          - Good for leaf_cert, signed directly by ca_key with ecdsa-with-SHA256 / ecdsa-with-SHA1
#   resp_sha256_cert / resp_sha1_cert      - OCSPSigning responder certificate issued by ca_key with ecdsa-with-SHA256 / ecdsa-with-SHA1
#   ocsp_delegated_ok / ocsp_delegated_sha1cert - Good for leaf_cert, signed ecdsa-with-SHA256 by the responder key, embedding resp_sha256_cert / resp_sha1_cert
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'); ca.pem/ca.key/leaf.pem are the CrlScope.txt fields converted with openssl x509/pkey:
#   ca.cnf: [ca] default_ca=tlslib_ca / [tlslib_ca] database=$ENV::IDX certificate=ca.pem private_key=ca.key crlnumber=crlnumber.txt default_crl_days=29200 policy=pol_any / [pol_any] commonName=optional
#   IDX=<index> openssl ca -config ca.cnf -md <sha1|sha256> -gencrl -crl_lastupdate 20200101000000Z -crl_nextupdate 20991231000000Z -out crl_X.pem
#     index_empty.txt is empty; index_rev.txt holds: R<TAB>20991231000000Z<TAB>200601000000Z,keyCompromise<TAB>1234<TAB>unknown<TAB>/CN=localhost
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out resp.key ; openssl req -new -key resp.key -subj "/CN=TlsLib Weak Responder" -out resp.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in resp.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -set_serial 0x2001|0x2002 -sha1|-sha256 -not_before 20200101000000Z -not_after 20991231000000Z -extfile resp.ext
#     resp.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=OCSPSigning
#   index_valid.txt: V<TAB>20991231000000Z<TAB><TAB>1234<TAB>unknown<TAB>/CN=localhost ; openssl ocsp -issuer ca.pem -cert leaf.pem -reqout req.der -no_nonce
#   openssl ocsp -index index_valid.txt -CA ca.pem -rsigner <signer.pem> -rkey <signer.key> -rmd <sha1|sha256> -ndays 36500 [-resp_no_certs] -no_nonce -reqin req.der -respout X.der
#     ocsp_ca_*: -rsigner ca.pem -resp_no_certs ; ocsp_delegated_*: -rsigner resp_sha256.pem|resp_sha1.pem -rkey resp.key (certificate embedded)
#   openssl ocsp -respin X.der -issuer ca.pem -cert leaf.pem -CAfile ca.pem -no_nonce   (each response verifies OK and reports good)
#   openssl crl -in crl_X.pem -CAfile ca.pem -noout   (verify OK) ; openssl x509|crl -outform DER | xxd -p (each field)
